categories.name: Packaging Identification
categories.logic: PPWR requires each packaging placed on the market to be uniquely identifiable and traceable (Art 3(1), Art 12(2), Annex VII). The TD must first lock the assessed object — UPI, product-SKU mapping, supplier & origin, mass/dimensions, artwork.
categories.logic_zh: PPWR 要求每件投放市场的包装可唯一识别与追溯（Art 3(1) 定义、Art 12(2) 标识追溯、Annex VII 技术文档）。技术文档首先要锁定「被评估的包装对象」——UPI、产品-SKU 对应、供应商与产地、质量尺寸、照片/Artwork。没有这层基线，后续可回收性、最小化、标签等条款评估都失去载体。
categories.sample_html: 通用示例：包装识别资料包——建议包含包装识别信息表、产品-SKU 对应表、供应商信息、质量尺寸记录、实物照片与最终 Artwork，文件命名如 01_Packaging_ID_PKG-xx_R1.pdf。

categories.name: Structure & BOM
categories.logic: Art 6 recyclability is assessed per packaging unit on its material composition, including integrated and separate components (Art 6(9), Annex II); Art 10 minimisation needs a mass/volume baseline (Annex IV Part B). Annex VII 2(b) requires the materials of components. The complete BOM is the quantitative backbone of all assessments.
categories.logic_zh: Art 6 可回收性按包装单元的材料组成评估，须涵盖集成组件与分离组件（Art 6(9)、Annex II）；Art 10 最小化需要质量/体积基线（Annex IV Part B）。Annex VII 2(b) 要求技术文档包含各组件材料。完整 BOM 是所有定量评估的基础。
categories.sample_html: 通用示例：结构资料包——BOM 表 + 各组件 TDS + 材料组成声明 + 油墨/胶黏剂/涂层规格书；每份文件标注组件名与版本。

categories.name: Design & Manufacturing
categories.logic: Art 6(1) design-for-recycling and Art 10(1) minimum-necessity require objective design and manufacturing evidence, which also anchors manufacturing consistency (TD §15).
categories.logic_zh: Art 6(1) 要求包装「按设计可回收」，Art 10(1) 要求证明重量/体积为满足功能的必要最小值。设计图纸、刀模图、Artwork、制造规格、控制计划是这两项评估的客观证据，同时为制造一致性（TD §15）提供基准。
categories.sample_html: 通用示例：设计制造资料包——图纸清单（编号/版本/日期）+ Artwork 批准版 + 制造规格书 + 控制计划；设计理由以叙述段说明。

categories.name: Substances of Concern
categories.logic: Art 5(4): the sum of Pb, Cd, Hg and Cr(VI) in packaging or packaging components shall not exceed 100 mg/kg (applies from 12 Aug 2026, Art 71). Art 5(5): from 12 Aug 2026 food-contact packaging must stay below 25 ppb for any PFAS (targeted analysis), 250 ppb for the sum of targeted PFAS and 50 ppm for total PFAS incl. polymeric PFAS. Art 5(6): compliance shall be demonstrated in the technical documentation (Annex VII).
categories.logic_zh: Art 5(4)：包装或包装组件中铅、镉、汞、六价铬四项浓度之和不得超过 100 mg/kg（2026-08-12 起适用，Art 71）。Art 5(5)：自 2026-08-12 起，食品接触包装中任一 PFAS（靶向分析）须 < 25 ppb、靶向 PFAS 总和 < 250 ppb、含聚合物 PFAS 的总 PFAS < 50 ppm。Art 5(6)：符合性须在技术文档（Annex VII）中证明。
categories.sample_html: 通用示例：物质要求证据包——重金属检测报告或供应商声明（四项总和 ≤100 mg/kg）+ PFAS 适用性判断记录 + 食品接触声明。

categories.name: Recyclability
categories.logic: Art 6(1): all packaging shall be recyclable. The design-for-recycling condition (Art 6(2)(a)) and grades A/B/C apply from 1 Jan 2030 or 24 months after the delegated acts enter into force, whichever is later; recycled at scale from 1 Jan 2035; only grades A/B from 1 Jan 2038 (Art 6(3)). Until the delegated acts exist, document the method used; EN 13430 can serve as guidance but no longer gives presumption of conformity (Commission FAQ 2026).
categories.logic_zh: Art 6(1)：所有包装须可回收。按设计可回收条件（Art 6(2)(a)）及 A/B/C 分级自 2030-01-01 或授权法案生效后 24 个月（以较晚者为准）适用；规模化回收自 2035-01-01；2038-01-01 起仅 A/B 级可投放（Art 6(3)）。授权法案出台前，记录实际采用的方法；EN 13430 可作为指引，但已不再产生符合性推定（欧盟委员会 FAQ 2026）。
categories.sample_html: 通用示例：可回收性证据包——可回收性评估（材料识别→质量占比→收集分选→工艺兼容）+ 组件相容性资料 + 采用方法/标准说明。

categories.name: Recycled Content
categories.logic: Art 7 sets minimum recycled content for the plastic part of packaging from 1 Jan 2030 or 3 years after the implementing act on calculation/verification (whichever later): 30 % contact-sensitive PET, 10 % other contact-sensitive, 30 % single-use plastic beverage bottles, 35 % other plastic packaging; higher targets from 2040. Plastic parts < 5 % of the unit weight are exempt (Art 7(5)(b)). Not applicable when the unit contains no plastic.
categories.logic_zh: Art 7 对包装中的塑料部分设定最低再生含量：自 2030-01-01 或计算/验证实施法案生效后 3 年（以较晚者为准）——接触敏感 PET 30%、其他接触敏感塑料 10%、一次性塑料饮料瓶 30%、其他塑料包装 35%；2040 年起目标提高。塑料部分低于包装单元总重 5% 的豁免（Art 7(5)(b)）。包装单元不含塑料时不适用。
categories.sample_html: 通用示例：再生料记录——纯纸基产品记录 N/A 及理由；含塑料组件时附 PCR 质量占比计算与供应商证明。

categories.name: Biobased Feedstock
categories.logic: Art 8 contains no obligation for manufacturers today: the Commission reviews biobased plastic packaging by 12 Feb 2028 and may propose requirements. Record N/A unless a biobased claim is made; substantiate any claim.
categories.logic_zh: Art 8 目前未对制造商设定义务：欧盟委员会将于 2028-02-12 前评估生物基塑料包装并可能提出要求。未作生物基声明时记录 N/A；如作声明，须有证据支持。
categories.sample_html: 通用示例：生物基记录——纸基产品记录 N/A；如作生物基声明附 ISO 16620-5 生物基碳测试。

categories.name: Compostability
categories.logic: Art 9(1): by 12 Feb 2028, packaging under Art 3(1)(1)(f) (e.g. tea/coffee bags and single-serve units) and sticky labels on fruit and vegetables must be compatible with industrial composting (Annex III); other packaging, incl. biodegradable plastics, must be designed for material recycling (Art 9(3)). Record N/A with rationale if out of scope.
categories.logic_zh: Art 9(1)：2028-02-12 前，Art 3(1)(1)(f) 所列包装（如茶包/咖啡包及单份装单元）和果蔬贴纸须满足工业堆肥要求（Annex III）；其他包装（含可生物降解塑料）须按材料回收设计（Art 9(3)）。不在范围内时记录 N/A 及理由。
categories.sample_html: 通用示例：可堆肥记录——判断是否属 Art 9 特定包装；如适用附 EN 13432 测试报告与堆肥标识。

categories.name: Minimisation
categories.logic: Art 10(1): by 1 Jan 2030 weight and volume must be reduced to the minimum necessary for functionality. Annex IV Part A lists eight performance criteria (product protection, manufacturing processes, logistics, functionality, information, hygiene and safety, legal requirements, recycled content/recyclability/re-use); Part B defines what the TD must contain. Art 24: max. 50 % empty-space ratio for grouped, transport and e-commerce packaging from 1 Jan 2030 (or 3 years after the implementing act).
categories.logic_zh: Art 10(1)：2030-01-01 前，包装重量和体积须降至确保功能所需的最低限度。Annex IV Part A 列出八项性能准则（产品保护、制造工艺、物流、功能性、信息要求、卫生与安全、法律要求、再生含量/可回收性/重复使用），Part B 规定技术文档须包含的内容。Art 24：组合、运输及电商包装的空隙率自 2030-01-01（或实施法案生效后 3 年）起不得超过 50%。
categories.sample_html: 通用示例：最小化证据包——最小化评估结论 + 产品保护/制造/物流/功能/信息等逐准则证据（测试、计算、设计说明）+ 空隙率记录。

categories.name: Reusability
categories.logic: Art 11(1) lists nine cumulative conditions for packaging to be considered reusable; compliance is demonstrated in the Annex VII technical information (Art 11(3)). Single-use packaging records N/A with rationale.
categories.logic_zh: Art 11(1) 列出包装被视为可重复使用须同时满足的九项条件，符合性在 Annex VII 技术资料中证明（Art 11(3)）。一次性包装记录 N/A 及理由。
categories.sample_html: 通用示例：可重复使用记录——一次性包装记录 N/A；如声明可重复使用须附循环次数、清洗、返回系统等证据。

categories.name: Labelling & Traceability
categories.logic: Art 12(1): harmonised material-composition label from 12 Aug 2028 or 24 months after the implementing acts (whichever later); reusable-packaging label from 12 Feb 2029 (Art 12(2)). Art 15(5)-(6) already apply from 12 Aug 2026: type/batch/serial number and the manufacturer's name and postal address on the packaging (or via QR / accompanying document).
categories.logic_zh: Art 12(1)：统一材料成分标签自 2028-08-12 或实施法案生效后 24 个月（以较晚者为准）起适用；可重复使用包装标签自 2029-02-12 起（Art 12(2)）。Art 15(5)-(6) 自 2026-08-12 起已适用：包装须标注型号/批号/序列号，以及制造商名称和邮寄地址（或通过二维码/随附文件提供）。
categories.sample_html: 通用示例：标签追溯资料包——最终 Artwork 各信息项位置标注 + 材料/处置/分选信息 + QR/数据载体说明。

categories.name: Risk & Change Control
categories.logic: Annex VII requires a risk analysis of non-conformity. Changes (material, supplier, formulation, inks, adhesives, mass/thickness, process, artwork, regulations) may invalidate approved conclusions — impact assessment before release.
categories.logic_zh: Annex VII 要求技术文档包含「不符合性风险分析」。变更（材料/供应商/配方/油墨/胶黏剂/质量厚度/工艺/Artwork/法规）可能使已批准结论失效，须在放行前做影响评估并在必要时重做评估。
categories.sample_html: 通用示例：风险与变更资料包——风险分析表 + 供应商变更通知承诺 + 材料/配方变更影响评估记录。

categories.name: Manufacturing Control
categories.logic: Art 15(4) and Annex VII point 3: the manufacturing process and its monitoring must keep series production in conformity with the technical documentation. Incoming inspection, in-process QC and release records evidence this.
categories.logic_zh: Art 15(4) 与 Annex VII 第 3 点：制造过程及其监控须确保量产包装持续符合技术文档。来料检验、过程 QC 与放行记录是证据链。
categories.sample_html: 通用示例：制造控制记录——来料检验（IQC）、首件/日常 QC、最终放行记录三件套，按批次归档。

categories.name: Standards & Evidence
categories.logic: Every conclusion must rest on standards plus objective evidence. The applicable-standards list and the Evidence Register (EV-xx) bridge the TD and the DoC (Art 39 / Annex VII / VIII).
categories.logic_zh: 每个评估结论须落到「标准/技术规范 + 客观证据」。适用标准清单（版本/日期/条款）与 Evidence Register（证据ID、来源、适用条款）是 TD 与 DoC 之间的桥梁（Art 39 / Annex VII / VIII）。
categories.sample_html: 通用示例：标准与证据管理——标准清单（EN 13427–13432 等）+ Evidence Register（EV-xx 与结论交叉引用）。

categories.name: Supplier Evidence
categories.logic: Most objective evidence (composition, heavy metals, PFAS, recyclability, change notification) originates in the supply chain. Supplier declarations must be traceable to the supplier's change control.
categories.logic_zh: 大部分客观证据（材料组成、重金属、PFAS、可回收性、变更通知）来自供应链。供应商声明/报告构成 TD 证据链，且须可追溯到供应商的变更控制承诺。
categories.sample_html: 通用示例：供应商证据包——供应商 PPWR 声明 + TDS + 材料组成 + 重金属/PFAS 声明 + 油墨胶黏剂声明 + 变更通知承诺。

categories.name: DoC & Approval
categories.logic: Art 39 + Annex VIII require the EU DoC. After the TD is complete, the three-level approval (Prepared/Reviewed/Approved) precedes the DoC signature; every conclusion is cross-referenced to evidence IDs.
categories.logic_zh: Art 39 + Annex VIII 要求 EU DoC。TD 完成后须经 Prepared / Reviewed / Approved 三级审批，DoC 由制造商签署；每项符合性结论与证据交叉引用（证据ID）。
categories.sample_html: 通用示例：DoC 与审批包——DoC 信息 + TD/证据交叉引用 + N/A 依据 + Prepared/Reviewed/Approved 审批记录。

items.name: Unique Packaging Identification (UPI)
items.name_zh: 包装唯一识别信息（UPI）
items.requirement_zh: Unique Packaging Identifier、包装名称/描述、包装类型
items.form_zh: 包装识别信息表/内部编码
items.legal: Annex VIII points 1 and 4 (unique identification); Art 15(5); Annex VII 2(a)
items.logic: The unique identification of the packaging (Annex VIII point 1) is the index used throughout the TD and the DoC; without it no conclusion can be anchored to a specific packaging.
items.logic_zh: 包装的唯一识别（Annex VIII 第 1 点）是贯穿技术文档与 DoC 的索引；没有它，任何结论都无法落到具体包装上。

fields.label: Packaging level (sales / grouped / transport / e-commerce)
fields.label_zh: 包装类型（销售/组合/运输/电商…）

items.example: UPI format PU-001 within packaging system PS-001; every SKU must trace to ≥ 1 UPI.

items.name: Product / SKU Mapping
items.name_zh: 产品 / SKU 对应关系
items.requirement_zh: Packaged product(s)、SKU/model range
items.logic: Defines which product and SKUs this packaging covers — the scope statement for TD §2 and the DoC.
items.logic_zh: 明确「这款包装装什么产品、覆盖哪些 SKU」，是 TD §2 与 DoC 的产品范围声明基础。

items.requirement_zh: Packaging supplier(s)、manufacturing site(s)、country of manufacture
items.legal: Annex VII; Art 15(4) series production stays in conformity
items.logic: Origin of the evidence chain (declarations, test reports) and input to supplier-change risk analysis.
items.logic_zh: 供应商与产地信息用于追溯证据链来源（供应商声明、测试报告签发方），也用于风险分析（供应商变更风险）。

items.name: Packaging Mass & Dimensions
items.name_zh: 包装质量及尺寸信息
items.requirement_zh: Packaging mass、dimensions
items.legal: Art 10 minimisation; Art 24 empty space; Annex IV
items.logic: Quantitative baseline for Art 10 minimisation and Art 24 void-space calculation, and cross-check for BOM masses.
items.logic_zh: 质量(g)与尺寸(mm)是最小化评估的定量基线，也是空隙率计算（Art 24）与 BOM 质量核对的输入。

尺寸210 × 297 × 0.3 mm

items.name: Photographs & Final Artwork
items.name_zh: 包装照片及最终 Artwork
items.requirement_zh: Photographs / artwork reference
items.logic: Visual reference for appearance, label positions, §13 labelling checks and artwork change control.
items.logic_zh: 实物照片与最终 Artwork 用于核对包装外观、标签信息位置，是 §13 标签评估与变更控制的参照基准。

fields.label: Photo / artwork reference
fields.label_zh: 照片 / Artwork 参考编号

items.example: JPG/PNG ≥ 1024×768, plain background, natural light, scale reference; name PU-001-C001-PHO-001.

items.name_zh: 完整包装 BOM
items.requirement_zh: 组件、材料/结构、质量(g)、尺寸(mm)、供应商/来源
items.logic: Core quantitative input for recyclability (component mass shares, compatibility) and minimisation; maps line-by-line to TD §3.
items.logic_zh: BOM 是可回收性（组件质量占比、相容性）与最小化（重量基线）的核心定量输入，逐行对应 TD §3 表格。
items.system: Built from the packaging BOM (Packaging & BOM tab).

items.name: Component Material Specifications / TDS
items.name_zh: 各组件材料规格书 / TDS
items.requirement_zh: Material specification / technical data sheet
items.logic: Confirms material identity and key properties of each component; part of the supplier evidence chain (§18).
items.logic_zh: TDS 证明各组件的材料身份与基本性能，支撑材料识别与可回收性判定，也是供应商证据链（§18）的组成部分。

items.name: Full Material Composition
items.name_zh: 完整材料组成资料
items.requirement: Full composition incl. additives and coatings
items.requirement_zh: Full material composition
items.logic: Substance inventory basis for the Art 5(4) heavy-metal assessment — avoids missing hidden constituents.
items.logic_zh: 完整材料组成（含添加剂、涂层）用于重金属限值评估的物质清单基础，避免漏检隐藏组分。

items.name: Inks / Adhesives / Coatings Data
items.name_zh: 油墨 / 胶黏剂 / 涂层资料
items.requirement_zh: Inks / adhesives / coatings declarations
items.legal: Art 6(9) components compatible with collection, sorting and recycling; Art 5(4)
items.logic: Inks, adhesives and coatings may contain heavy metals or hinder recycling of the main body; Art 6(9) requires all components to be compatible with collection, sorting and recycling.
items.logic_zh: 油墨、胶黏剂和涂层可能含重金属或妨碍主体材料回收；Art 6(9) 要求所有组件与收集、分选、回收工艺相容。

items.name: Packaging Design Drawings
items.name_zh: 包装设计图纸
items.requirement_zh: Packaging drawing
items.logic: Locks the structural design — the objective basis for recyclability and minimisation assessments.
items.logic_zh: 正式设计图纸锁定包装结构，是可回收设计评估与最小化论证的客观载体。
items.example: Drawing revision must match the artwork revision.

items.name_zh: 结构 / 刀模图
items.requirement_zh: Die-cut / structural drawing
items.logic: Confirms blank geometry and forming method; used to judge recycling-process compatibility and reduction potential.
items.logic_zh: 刀模图确认纸板展开结构与成型方式，用于判断回收工艺相容性与结构减量空间。

items.name: Artwork / Label Design
items.name_zh: Artwork / 标签设计
items.requirement_zh: Artwork / label design
items.legal: Art 12 labelling; Art 15(5)-(6); Art 6(9) component compatibility
items.logic: Baseline version for §13 label verification and §15 artwork change control.
items.logic_zh: 最终批准版 Artwork 是 §13 标签信息核对与 §15 Artwork 变更控制的基准版本。

items.name: Manufacturing Specification
items.name_zh: 制造规格书
items.requirement_zh: Manufacturing specification
items.logic: Defines mass-production conditions (grammage, thickness, tolerances) for §15 manufacturing control.
items.logic_zh: 制造规格书定义量产条件（克重、厚度、公差），是制造控制（§15）与一致性核查的依据。

items.name: Process / Control Plan

items.logic: Narrative core of §4 and §11: why this structure/material/mass, and why it is the minimum necessary design.

items.name: Food-contact Declaration of Compliance (evidence)
items.name_zh: 食品接触符合性声明（证明文件）

items.name: Recyclability Assessment
items.name_zh: 可回收性评估资料
items.requirement: Material ID, main components & mass shares, collection/sorting, process compatibility
items.requirement_zh: 材料识别、主要组件及质量占比、收集/分选、回收工艺兼容性
items.legal: Art 6(1)-(3), Annex II; design-for-recycling condition from 1 Jan 2030 (Art 6(2)); Art 6(9) TD
items.logic: Recyclability assessment of the unit and its components: material identification, main-component mass shares, collection/sorting stream and recycling-process compatibility. Record the method used until the delegated acts on design-for-recycling criteria apply; the conclusion feeds TD §7.
items.logic_zh: 包装单元及其组件的可回收性评估：材料识别、主要组件质量占比、收集分选流向、回收工艺相容性。在设计可回收授权法案适用前，记录实际采用的方法；结论填入 TD §7。

fields.label: Recyclability assessment conclusion
fields.label_zh: 可回收性评估结论（叙述）

items.example: Mono-material paper: EN 13430 material-recycling route — material ID, main-component mass share, collection/sorting, compatibility of inks, adhesives, coatings and labels.
items.sample_html:
示例：可回收性评估结论（过渡期方法 EN 13430）

材料识别：单材质纸基（PAP 20），主要组件为色卡纸板（质量占比 >95%）。
收集分选：进入欧盟纸 / 纸板回收流（paper & board stream）。
工艺兼容性：水性油墨可脱墨；无覆膜、无塑料封口；胶黏剂为回收相容类型。
结论：按设计可回收（recyclable by design）——过渡期评估，待实施法案分级后复核。

items.name: Component Compatibility Data
items.name_zh: 组件相容性资料
items.requirement_zh: 封口、标签、油墨、胶黏剂、涂层等
items.logic: Ancillary components must be shown compatible (de-inkable, separable) with the recycling route, or assessed as integrated components per Art 6(3).
items.logic_zh: 胶订/贴标/覆膜/特殊油墨都可能影响纸基回收。需证明各辅助件与回收工艺相容（如可脱墨、可分离），或按集成组件规则评估。
items.sample_html:
示例：组件相容性声明（油墨 / 胶黏剂 / 标签）

油墨：水性油墨，符合脱墨性要求（INGEDE 方法 11 类试验通过）。
胶黏剂：淀粉基 / 可再制浆胶，不影响纸基回收。
标签 / 涂层：无覆膜；若采用不干胶标签须可分离或可再制浆。
结论：各辅助件与纸基回收工艺相容（Art 6(3) 组件规则）。

items.name: Applicable Method / Standards Basis
items.name_zh: 当前适用方法 / 标准依据
items.requirement_zh: 实际采用的过渡期方法和标准
items.legal: Art 6(4) — method before the delegated acts apply
items.logic: Record the transitional method applied (e.g. EN 13430 + industry practice) until the harmonised grading implementing act applies.
items.logic_zh: 在可回收性分级（A/B/C）实施法案生效前，记录实际采用的方法（如 EN 13430 + 国家/行业标准），避免过早套用未来分级。

fields.label: Method / standard applied (e.g. EN 13430 used as guidance)
fields.label_zh: 实际采用的方法 / 标准

items.name: Recycled Content Data (if applicable)
items.name_zh: 塑料包装再生料含量资料（如适用）
items.requirement: Total mass, PCR mass, calculation basis, requirements/exemptions
items.requirement_zh: 总质量、PCR质量、计算基础、适用要求/豁免
items.form_zh: PCR证明、供应商声明、计算资料
items.logic: Required only for the plastic part of packaging (Art 7). Record plastic mass, recycled (post-consumer) mass and the calculation basis, or the N/A / exemption rationale (no plastic part, or plastic < 5 % of unit weight).
items.logic_zh: 仅针对包装中的塑料部分（Art 7）。记录塑料质量、消费后再生料质量及计算依据，或记录 N/A / 豁免理由（无塑料部分，或塑料低于单元重量 5%）。
items.example: Plastic parts only: plastic mass (g), PCR mass (g), PCR %, with ISCC PLUS / RCS chain of custody.

items.name: Recycled Content Verification (if applicable)
items.name_zh: 再生料验证证据（如适用）
items.requirement_zh: 符合条件的再生输入及验证
items.legal: Art 7(3), 7(6) and 7(8) calculation and verification of recycled content
items.logic: Where Art 7 applies: show that the recycled input meets Art 7(3) and that the calculation will follow the implementing act under Art 7(8) once adopted.
items.logic_zh: Art 7 适用时：证明再生原料满足 Art 7(3) 条件，并在 Art 7(8) 实施法案通过后按其方法计算与验证。

items.name: Biobased Feedstock Data (if applicable)
items.name_zh: 生物基原料资料（如适用）
items.requirement_zh: 材料/配方、生物基原料占比
items.logic: Art 8 sets no manufacturer obligation today. Record N/A unless a biobased claim is made; substantiate any claim (e.g. biobased carbon content by a recognised method).
items.logic_zh: Art 8 目前无制造商义务。除非作出生物基声明，否则记录 N/A；如作声明须提供证据（如按公认方法测定生物基碳含量）。

items.name: Related Labelling / Disposal Info (if applicable)
items.name_zh: 相关标签 / 处置信息（如适用）
items.requirement_zh: Labelling / disposal information
items.logic: If a biobased claim is made, on-pack information must support it and be checked in §13.
items.logic_zh: 如作出生物基声明，标签信息须支持该声明并纳入 §13 核对。

items.name: Compostability Applicability (if applicable)
items.name_zh: 可堆肥性适用性判断（如适用）
items.requirement: Whether the packaging falls under Art 9 scope
items.requirement_zh: 是否属于需满足堆肥性要求的包装
items.legal: Art 9: tea/coffee pods, fruit stickers, very lightweight bags (from 12 Feb 2028)
items.logic: Decide whether the packaging is one of the formats in Art 9(1) (by 12 Feb 2028 compostable); otherwise record N/A with the rationale.
items.logic_zh: 判断包装是否属于 Art 9(1) 所列形式（2028-02-12 前须可堆肥）；否则记录 N/A 及理由。

fields.label: Compostability (Art 9 packaging)
fields.label_zh: 是否属于 Art 9 特定包装

items.name: Compostability Testing / Declaration (if applicable)
items.name_zh: 堆肥性测试 / 声明（如适用）
items.requirement_zh: 材料、工业/家庭堆肥路线
items.legal: Art 9; Annex III; EN 13432 industrial composting
items.logic: If applicable: EN 13432 test report or supplier declaration stating the composting route.
items.logic_zh: 如适用：提供 EN 13432 检测报告或供应商声明，说明堆肥路线。

items.requirement_zh: Labelling / disposal information
items.logic: If applicable, the compostability mark must appear on-pack and be verified in §13.
items.logic_zh: 如适用：可堆肥标识须出现在包装上并纳入 §13 核对。

items.name: Packaging Minimisation Assessment
items.name_zh: 包装最小化评估
items.requirement_zh: 证明包装满足最低必要重量/体积
items.legal: Art 10(1) from 1 Jan 2030; Annex IV performance criteria
items.logic: Summary conclusion consolidating the eight Annex IV Part A criteria and the Part B elements (calculation of the minimum weight/volume, reason preventing further reduction per criterion, tests/studies). Feeds TD §11.
items.logic_zh: 最小化评估总结论：汇总 Annex IV Part A 八项准则及 Part B 要素（最低重量/体积计算、各准则下无法进一步减量的设计原因、测试/研究）。结论填入 TD §11。
items.example: Address each Annex IV criterion separately; if no further reduction is possible, give the technical reason.
items.sample_html:
示例：最小化评估结论（Art 10(1) + Annex IV 八项准则）

当前包装质量 14 g，为满足功能的最低必要值：
1) 产品保护：色卡平整度与运输堆码强度（跌落/压缩测试通过）；
2) 制造工艺：300 g/m² 为印刷与模切稳定运行的最低克重；
3) 物流：满足堆码抗压与货架展示；
4) 包装功能性：翻盖 / 挂孔 / 开启关闭结构；
5) 信息承载：标签与印刷信息所需面积；
6-7) 卫生 / 安全：非食品接触，不构成额外要求；
8) 法律要求：标签法规所需面积已计入。
结论：任何进一步减量将影响产品保护或印刷质量，符合 Art 10 最小化（过渡期记录）。

items.requirement_zh: 开启、封闭、使用等功能必要性

items.name: Information / Hygiene / Safety Evidence
items.name_zh: 信息 / 卫生 / 安全证据

items.name: Void-space Assessment (if applicable)
items.name_zh: 空隙评估（如适用）
items.requirement_zh: Article 24 适用范围、日期及方法
items.form_zh: 尺寸数据、空隙计算及依据
items.legal: Art 24: empty space ratio ≤ 50 % (grouped, transport, e-commerce) from 2030
items.logic: Record whether Art 24 applies (grouped, transport, e-commerce: ≤ 50 % from 2030; sales packaging: empty space reduced to the minimum necessary by 12 Feb 2028, Art 24(4)) and the method used.
items.logic_zh: 记录 Art 24 是否适用（组合、运输、电商包装：2030 起 ≤ 50%；销售包装：2028-02-12 前空隙须降至必要最低，Art 24(4)）及所用方法。

items.name: Double-wall / False-bottom Exemption (if applicable)
items.name_zh: 双层壁 / 假底等例外证据（如适用）
items.requirement_zh: Article 10(2) 例外及相关条件
items.legal: Art 10(2)-(3): double walls, false bottoms; design rights before 11 Feb 2025
items.logic: If the packaging contains double walls/false bottoms/unnecessary layers, demonstrate they fall under the Art 10(2) exemption (design rights before 2025-02-11).
items.logic_zh: 若包装含双层壁/假底/非必要层，须证明其落入 Art 10(2) 例外条件（2025-02-11 前的设计权等）。

fields.label: Double wall / false bottom
fields.label_zh: 是否存在双层壁/假底等

items.name: Reusability Assessment (if applicable)
items.name_zh: 可重复使用性评估（如适用）
items.requirement_zh: 重复使用设计、循环次数/寿命、清空/再装填
items.logic: Single-use packaging → N/A. If reusability is claimed, all nine Art 11(1) conditions must be demonstrated.
items.logic_zh: 一次性包装 → N/A。如声明可重复使用，须证明满足 Art 11(1) 全部九项条件。

items.name: Reuse Performance / Safety Evidence (if applicable)
items.name_zh: 重复使用性能 / 安全证据（如适用）
items.requirement: Performance, safety and maintenance after reuse
items.requirement_zh: 重复使用后的性能、安全、维修维护
items.logic: If applicable: prove performance and safety after repeated use, incl. maintainability (Art 11(1)(c)(d)).
items.logic_zh: 如适用：证明重复使用后性能安全、可维修维护。

items.name: Return / Cleaning System Data (if applicable)
items.name_zh: 回收 / 返回 / 清洗系统资料（如适用）
items.requirement_zh: Collection/return、cleaning/washing
items.logic: If applicable: describe the return system and cleaning stage (Art 11(1)(e)(f)).
items.logic_zh: 如适用：说明回收返回系统与清洗环节。

items.name: Manufacturer / EO Information on Artwork
items.name_zh: 制造商 / 经济运营者信息 Artwork
items.requirement_zh: 信息及其在包装上的位置
items.legal: Art 15(6) manufacturer name / trade name / trademark and postal address
items.logic: Collect the final artwork and verify the manufacturer/economic-operator information and its position — input for §13.
items.logic_zh: 收集最终 Artwork，核对制造商/经济运营者信息及在包装上的具体位置，为 §13 表格输入。

fields.label: Position of the information on the artwork

items.name: Packaging Identification / Traceability Info
items.name_zh: 包装识别 / 追溯信息
items.requirement_zh: Packaging identification / traceability information
items.legal: Art 15(5) type, batch or serial number
items.logic: Carrier of the type, batch or serial number or other identification element required by Art 15(5).
items.logic_zh: Art 15(5) 要求的型号、批号、序列号或其他识别元素的载体与方案。

items.name: Material / Disposal / Sorting Info
items.name_zh: 材料 / 处置 / 分选信息
items.requirement_zh: Material/disposal/sorting information
items.legal: Art 12(1) harmonised material-composition label (from 12 Aug 2028 or 24 months after the implementing act)
items.logic: How material composition and sorting information appear on-pack today, and the plan for the harmonised Art 12(1) label once the implementing act applies.
items.logic_zh: 当前包装上材料成分与分选信息的呈现方式，以及实施法案适用后切换为 Art 12(1) 统一标签的计划。

items.name: Data Carrier / QR (if applicable)
items.name_zh: 数据载体 / QR（如适用）
items.requirement: Data carrier / QR and linked content
items.requirement_zh: Data carrier / QR 及对应信息
items.legal: Art 12(1) optional QR code / digital data carrier; Art 12(2) for reusable packaging
items.logic: If a QR code / data carrier is used, record its content and destination and bind it to the packaging identity.
items.logic_zh: 如使用二维码/数据载体，记录其内容与跳转目标，并与包装身份绑定。

items.name: Reuse / DRS Marking (if applicable)
items.name_zh: 重复使用 / DRS 标识（如适用）
items.requirement_zh: Reuse / DRS marking
items.legal: Art 12(2) reusable-packaging label; Art 12(1) deposit-and-return label
items.logic: Not applicable for single-use packaging; record the marking and basis if applicable.
items.logic_zh: 一次性包装不涉及；如适用须记录标识及依据。

items.name: Member State-specific Info (if applicable)
items.name_zh: 成员国特定信息（如适用）
items.requirement_zh: Member State-specific information
items.form_zh: 对应成员国标签/信息资料
items.logic: Record national identification requirements (EPR symbol, national DRS symbol) for the target markets.
items.logic_zh: 记录目标市场的国家识别要求（EPR 标识、国家押金回收标识）。

items.name: PPWR Risk Analysis
items.name_zh: PPWR 风险分析
items.requirement: Cause, probability, severity, risk level, controls
items.requirement_zh: 风险原因、概率、严重性、风险等级、控制/缓解措施
items.logic: Non-conformity risk table (heavy metals, recyclability, minimisation failure) with control measures — core of TD §14.
items.logic_zh: 风险分析表（重金属不符、可回收性受影响、最小化失效等）及控制措施，是 TD §14 的核心内容。
items.example: Risk of non-conformity per applicable article — likelihood, impact, control.
items.sample_html:
示例：PPWR 风险分析表（TD §14）

风险原因概率严重性等级控制 / 缓解
重金属不符油墨/纸板污染低高中供应商声明 + 定期检测
可回收性受影响油墨/胶黏剂变更低中中变更控制 + 供应商通知
最小化失效克重/厚度增加低中低规格变更复核

items.name: Supplier Change-control Data
items.name_zh: 供应商变更控制资料
items.requirement_zh: 材料/工艺变化通知机制
items.legal: Art 15(4) re-assessment when design or supply changes
items.logic: Suppliers must commit to notify before any material/process change — the trigger mechanism for change impact assessment.
items.logic_zh: 供应商须承诺材料/工艺变化前通知，作为变更影响评估的触发机制。

items.name: Material / Formulation Change Assessment
items.name_zh: 材料 / 配方变更评估
items.requirement: Impact of changes on PPWR compliance
items.requirement_zh: 变更对 PPWR 符合性的影响
items.logic: Changes must be assessed against Art 5/6/10 conclusions; re-test where necessary.
items.logic_zh: 材料/配方变更须评估对 Art 5/6/10 结论的影响，必要时重做检测。

items.name: Mass / Thickness / Dimension Change Records
items.name_zh: 重量 / 厚度 / 尺寸变更记录
items.requirement_zh: 规格变化后的确认
items.logic: Mass/thickness changes directly affect the minimisation conclusion; must be recorded and re-verified.
items.logic_zh: 质量/厚度变化直接影响最小化结论，须记录并复核。

items.name: Artwork Change-control Records
items.name_zh: Artwork 变更控制记录
items.requirement_zh: 变更前法规审核
items.logic: Every artwork revision requires a prior regulatory review (label information, recycling symbols) to prevent misleading claims.
items.logic_zh: Artwork 每次修订须先做法规复核（标签信息、回收标识），防止宣传/标识失实。

items.name: Incoming Inspection Records
items.name_zh: 来料检验记录
items.requirement: Supplier spec, mass and dimension checks
items.requirement_zh: 供应商规格、重量、尺寸检查
items.logic: Incoming QC ensures deliveries match the BOM and specifications (Art 15(2)).
items.logic_zh: 来料检验（规格/克重/尺寸）确保供应商交付符合 BOM 与规格书。

items.name: Production Consistency Records
items.name_zh: 生产一致性控制记录
items.requirement_zh: 首件及日常 QC
items.logic: First-article approval plus routine QC prove that mass production continuously matches the approved design.
items.logic_zh: 首件确认 + 日常 QC 证明量产过程持续符合批准设计。

items.name: Final Release Records
items.name_zh: 最终放行记录
items.requirement_zh: QC 接受后放行
items.logic: Only QC-passed batches are released; the release record is the last evidence before placing on the market.
items.logic_zh: 仅 QC 合格的批次放行，放行记录是产品投放市场前的最后证据。

items.name: Applicable Standards / Specifications List
items.name_zh: 适用标准 / 技术规范清单
items.requirement_zh: 标准、版本/日期、条款、对应要求、证据
items.legal: Annex VII 2(d); Art 36–37 harmonised standards and common specifications
items.logic: Register of all standards used (EN 13427–13432, ISO 16620-5, test methods) with versions and clauses — feeds TD §16.
items.logic_zh: 登记所有评估所用的标准/规范（EN 13427–13432、ISO 16620-5、检测方法等）及版本条款，供 TD §16 引用。
items.example: EN 13427–EN 13432 (former PPWD harmonised standards — under the PPWR used as guidance only, no presumption of conformity, Commission FAQ 2026), EN 13657 + ICP-OES for heavy metals.
items.sample_html:
示例：适用标准清单（TD §16）

标准 / 规范版本用途
EN 13430:20042004材料回收（Art 6 过渡期评估）
EN 13428:20042004最小化准则（Art 10）
EN 13432:20002000可堆肥（如适用）
ISO 16620-5现行生物基碳含量（如适用）

items.name: Evidence Register
items.name_zh: Evidence Register
items.requirement: Evidence ID, file name, type, version/date, issuer, requirement, location
items.requirement_zh: Evidence ID、文件名、类型、版本/日期、供应商/签发方、适用要求、附件位置
items.legal: Annex VII 2(f) test reports; Annex VIII
items.logic: All approved items are auto-aggregated as EV-xx and auto-filled into TD §17 during draft generation.
items.logic_zh: 全部已批准素材自动汇总为证据登记表（EV-xx），并可在生成草稿时自动填入 TD §17。
items.system: Built from the evidence vault — every file carries its Evidence ID.

items.name: Supplier PPWR Compliance Statement
items.name_zh: 供应商 PPWR 符合性声明
items.requirement_zh: Supplier PPWR compliance statement
items.legal: Art 16 supplier information obligations; Art 15(2) conformity assessment
items.logic: The supplier's overall commitment to PPWR requirements — the umbrella declaration of the evidence chain.
items.logic_zh: 供应商对 PPWR 相关要求的符合性承诺，作为证据链的总声明。
items.example: Signed supplier declaration per key component, dated and referencing PPWR (EU) 2025/40.
items.sample_html:
示例：供应商 PPWR 符合性声明（要点）

致：【产品制造商名称】
兹声明，我司供应的【材料/组件名称】符合 Regulation (EU) 2025/40 相关要求：
- 重金属（Pb+Cd+Hg+Cr(VI)）四项总和 ≤ 100 mg/kg（Art 5(4)）；
- 产品成分与送样一致；材料/工艺变更前 30 日书面通知；
- 配合提供材料组成、TDS 及检测报告。
供应商（盖章）：________   签字：________   日期：________

items.name: Supplier Material Spec / TDS
items.name_zh: 供应商材料规格 / TDS
items.requirement_zh: Material specification / TDS
items.logic: Supplier-issued counterpart of C02-07.
items.logic_zh: 与 C02-07 对应：供应商签发的规格文件。

items.name: Supplier Full Material Composition
items.name_zh: 供应商完整材料组成
items.requirement_zh: Full material composition
items.logic: Supplier-issued counterpart of C02-08.
items.logic_zh: 与 C02-08 对应：供应商签发的材料组成声明。

items.name: Supplier Heavy-metal Declaration / Report
items.name_zh: 供应商重金属声明 / 报告
items.requirement_zh: Heavy-metal declaration and/or test report
items.logic: Supplier-side counterpart of C04-16; third-party reports preferred.
items.logic_zh: 与 C04-16 对应：供应商侧的重金属证据（第三方报告优先）。

items.name: Supplier PFAS Declaration / Report (if applicable)
items.name_zh: 供应商 PFAS 声明 / 报告（如适用）
items.requirement_zh: PFAS declaration / test report
items.logic: Counterpart of C04-17; N/A statement for non food-contact products.
items.logic_zh: 与 C04-17 对应：非食品接触场景记录 N/A 声明。

items.name: Supplier Food-contact Declaration (if applicable)
items.name_zh: 供应商食品接触声明（如适用）
items.requirement_zh: Food-contact declaration
items.logic: Counterpart of C04-18 — confirms the food-contact attribute.
items.logic_zh: 与 C04-18 对应：确认食品接触属性。

items.name: Supplier Recycled-content Evidence (if applicable)
items.name_zh: 供应商再生料证据（如适用）
items.requirement_zh: Recycled-content evidence
items.logic: Supplier counterpart of C06-22/23; N/A when the unit has no plastic part.
items.logic_zh: C06-22/23 的供应商侧证据；包装单元无塑料部分时为 N/A。

items.name: Supplier Recyclability / Material Data
items.name_zh: 供应商可回收性 / 材料资料
items.requirement_zh: Recyclability / material evidence
items.logic: Counterpart of C05-19/20 — supplier-provided recyclability technical data.
items.logic_zh: 与 C05-19/20 对应：供应商提供的可回收性技术资料。

items.name: Ink / Adhesive / Coating Declarations
items.name_zh: 油墨 / 胶黏剂 / 涂层声明
items.requirement_zh: Inks / adhesives / coatings declarations
items.logic: Counterpart of C02-09 — declarations on de-inkability, adhesives and coatings.
items.logic_zh: 与 C02-09 对应：油墨（可脱墨性）、胶黏剂、涂层的供应商声明。

items.name: Manufacturing / Change-control Notification
items.name_zh: 制造过程 / 变更控制通知
items.requirement_zh: Manufacturing process / change-control notification
items.logic: Counterpart of C12-47 — the supplier's commitment to notify process/material changes.
items.logic_zh: 与 C12-47 对应：供应商对工艺/材料变更的通知承诺。

items.name: EU DoC Data
items.name_zh: EU DoC 所需资料
items.requirement: DoC No., packaging ID, TD No./version, date, signatory
items.requirement_zh: DoC编号、包装识别、TD编号/版本、日期、签署人
items.legal: Art 39 + Annex VIII (EU declaration of conformity)
items.logic: DoC issuance information: number, packaging identification (UPI), corresponding TD, issue date and signatory (Art 39 + Annex VIII).
items.logic_zh: DoC 签发信息：编号、包装识别（UPI）、对应 TD 编号/版本、签发日期与签署人。
items.example: DoC number with year-month, e.g. DoC-2026-09-PS001; signed by a person with authority.

items.name: TD ↔ Evidence Cross-references
items.name_zh: TD 与证据交叉引用
items.requirement: Each conclusion mapped to Evidence IDs
items.requirement_zh: 每项结论对应 Evidence ID 及客观证据
items.logic: Every conformity conclusion must trace back to evidence (EV-xx); the system builds these cross-references automatically during generation.
items.logic_zh: 每个符合性结论须可回溯到证据（EV-xx），本系统在生成草稿时自动建立交叉引用。
items.system: Cross-references are generated with the TD from approved items and evidence.

items.name: N/A / Transitional Item Rationale
items.name_zh: N/A / 过渡期项目依据
items.requirement_zh: 法律依据和理由
items.legal: Annex VII — rationale for N/A items
items.logic: Each N/A clause must state its legal basis and reasoning (e.g. Art 7 applies to plastic packaging only); auto-aggregated in the compliance matrix.
items.logic_zh: 每个 N/A 条款须写明法律依据与理由（如 Art 7 仅适用塑料包装），系统在合规矩阵中自动汇总。
items.system: Generated from the applicability matrix (Overview tab).

items.name: Technical File Approval Records
items.name_zh: 技术文件审批资料
items.requirement_zh: Prepared / Reviewed / Approved 人员、签字、日期
items.legal: Annex VII point 4 — manufacturer approval before the DoC is signed
items.logic: The DoC may only be signed after the three-level approval of the TD is complete.
items.logic_zh: TD 完成并经三级审批后方可签发 DoC。记录审批人、签字与日期。
